text: Your 420 mango trees on 2.13 hectares show healthy vegetation (NDVI 0.62); the vegetation index has risen about 12% over the evaluated period. A documented biomass model suggests they remove about 10.6 tonnes of CO₂e per year (roughly 7.4 to 13.8). Confidence in this estimate is medium. Whether this can become a Green Credit or a carbon credit depends on evidence you do not have yet: tree diameter measurements, a land-use baseline. This is a scenario estimate, not an issued credit.
privacy_note: Only derived indicators were used; no coordinates or personal data were processed.
